results.name: The complete shipped application mounts the scene navigator without startup errors
Description reads canonical relationships without changing project bytes or history
Existing scene selection and the real asset-append lifecycle refresh the navigator immediately
Recovered pages group by exact source hash, profile and native room identity
World selection follows its declared tileset scene without altering its data
Cross-tab scene navigation saves live pixels and restores them when returning
Pose navigation opens the exact related canonical pose
Shared animation opens the first frame that actually refers to the active scene
Legacy implicit tile sources are disclosed and follow active-scene behavior
Missing and stale IDs are refused before changing navigation or project state
Source receipts cannot silently select or replace an unrelated RE source
Reopen reconstructs context from existing receipts without adding project fields
Navigator keyboard events remain isolated from authoring and emulator handlers
